evidence: Has the P2P label and modifies address advertisement in src/net.cpp and src/netbase.cpp.
rationale: Prevents nodes from gossiping unreachable proxy exit IPs and polluting peers' address managers. The author notes that 55-76% of Tor exit nodes were present in observed addrman snapshots due to this self-advertisement behavior, making this a clear network hygiene improvement that is reasonably deferrable.
